title: AI in video game development: How artificial intelligence is reshaping the industry
summary: An industry overview report revealing that 90% of developers are integrating AI into daily workflows, with Steam showing a 681% increase in AI-disclosed titles in 2025 (7,818 titles). The article positions AI as a fundamental transformation of the entire game development pipeline, not just experimental additions.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing need to understand how AI is transforming video game development workflows and industry practices.
why_valuable: Provides concrete data showing AI adoption is mainstream in gaming, with nearly universal developer integration and exponential growth in disclosed usage.
